g.id: cluster_Digital stethoscope / evaluation carrier Rev A
g.text: Digital stethoscope / evaluation carrier Rev A
Solid links: configured local interfaces, not proof of physical acceptance.
Dashed links: optional networking; default firmware is offline.
Display, touch and SD share SPI2 with separate CS lines.
Speed switch and SD wiring remain outside the recorded wiring confirmation.
Created by GPT-6.1-Sol on behalf of Nico running in codex.
